title: RINGTA SCRIPTS Keyless Autoblock, Hitbox Expander, And More

- Complete ESP Suite (Killer ESP, Survivors ESP, Generators, Items, Traps, Footprints, Rituals & more)

- Advanced Path Visualizer (see optimal paths to escape killers)

- Anti-Disable Tech (Anti Stun, Anti Slow, disables slowness UI & effects)

- Trick Helper (auto platform, bumber superfling, customizable timing)
- Advanced Mobility: Super Fling Pitch/Range controls, Flight Control (Nosferatu)
- Orbit Mode (orbit any player or killer for evasion, custom speed/distance)
- AI Killer Mode (auto target/switch, path prediction/lock, stuck detection)
- Custom LMS (Last Survivor) music and UI tweaks
- Guest Anim Quick Play, Hide Name Feature, Anti-1x1x1x1 popups
- Aimbot Suite: CamLock, CharLock, Hybrid, Smooth Prediction, Mobile/PC GUI
- Mobile friendly controls, cross-platform keybinds and toggles
- NEW: Stamina Checker HUD (displays stamina above all players' heads, with movement state)
- NEW: Hitbox Visualization for killer types, with instant visual feedback
- NEW: Complete Anti-Wrong Block & Anti-Spin Bait engine
